lastCompletedStory.title: Log a durable event on non-ok pattern-outcome append

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-336) added the 'pattern-outcome-append-failed' WorkerEventKind + PatternOutcomeAppendFailedEventDetail ({ recordId, reason }) to src/supervisor/events.ts, and threaded an optional WorkerEventLogger param into makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn (host.ts, backward-compatible additive signature: existing makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn(cwd) callers unaffected). sidecar.ts's buildSidecarLoopDeps now wires makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn(cwd, logEvent). appendOutcomeOnMain (src/commands/pattern-records.ts) is untouched. 2 new tests added to test/supervisor/loop.test.ts (real tmpdir git repo, mirroring the existing AC4 fixture): non-ok (not-found) append logs exactly one failure event with correct recordId/reason, ok:true append logs none. File-size ceilings raised for events.ts (761->786), host.ts (1090->1108), loop.test.ts (4434->4500), _ref updated in scripts/file-size-budget.json.
